sources.kind: repository project and accession-scoped file list

claims.location: source name, characteristics[genotype], factor value[genotype], characteristics[biological replicate], comment[label]
claims.value: Two wild-type mIMCD-3 clones at TMT126 and TMT127; TMEM260 knockout clone 1 at TMT128 and TMT129; knockout clone 2 at TMT130 and TMT131
claims.evidence: The publication's TMT Labeling of mIMCD-3 Total Cell Digests section gives the six-channel clone map verbatim. Each knockout clone occupies two channels. Biological replicate numbers identify clones within genotype; the two channels for each knockout clone are marked as technical channel replicates and do not imply independent cultures. All four RAW filenames repeat the same channel map.

claims.location: characteristics[organism], characteristics[material type], characteristics[cell line], characteristics[cellosaurus accession], characteristics[sampling site], characteristics[developmental stage], characteristics[culture medium details]
claims.value: Mouse mIMCD-3 kidney collecting-duct cell line, CVCL_0429; adult origin; DMEM/F12 with 10% FBS and 1% GlutaMAX
claims.evidence: The paper's Cell Culture and TMT Labeling sections identify mIMCD-3 cells and medium. Cellosaurus identifies mIMCD-3 as a mouse inner medullary collecting-duct line derived from an adult kidney. Kidney is the line's tissue of origin, not a directly sampled organ in these assays.

claims.location: comment[data file], comment[fraction identifier], comment[instrument], comment[proteomics data acquisition method]
claims.value: Four high-pH fractions 5-8, each carrying the same TMT six-plex, acquired on Orbitrap Fusion Lumos using data-dependent acquisition
claims.evidence: The accession-scoped PRIDE list has the four 200327_Lumos mIMCD3 RAW files ending High_pH_5 through High_pH_8, plus deposited ETD search outputs. The paper describes the Fusion Lumos instrument and data-dependent precursor selection.

claims.value: HCD and ETciD MS/MS, Orbitrap MS2 analysis
claims.evidence: The paper's Mass Spectrometry section describes paired Orbitrap HCD and electron-transfer/collision-induced dissociation spectra at MS2 resolution 60,000. The RAW filenames include ETD_HCD. The controlled dissociation columns represent HCD and the exact PRIDE ontology term for ETciD.

claims.location: comment[cleavage agent details], comment[reduction reagent], comment[alkylation reagent], comment[modification parameters]
claims.value: Trypsin; DTT and iodoacetamide; fixed carbamidomethyl C and TMT6plex K/peptide N-terminus; variable oxidation M and Hex S/T
claims.evidence: The paper specifies trypsin, DTT, iodoacetamide, fixed carbamidomethyl C and TMT6plex K/peptide N-terminus, and variable oxidation M and Hex S/T for this experiment. Its TMT protocol states proteins were extracted and digested as in the preceding dimethyl protocol. The reported Hex mass and residues match Unimod 41.

limitations: This artifact covers only the four 200327 Lumos mIMCD-3 RAW files; the remaining PXD032328 acquisitions require separate interpretation and annotation.
The Lumos ETD .msf files were not inspected; run-specific precursor and fragment search tolerances are omitted.
The publication does not state whether duplicated knockout reporter channels were separate digestions or split aliquots; technical replicate numbers distinguish channels only.
No donor sex or exact mouse strain was reported for the cell line, so those values are not inferred.
